pages.text: Dark Matter Armor is the first alchemical armor tier. Craft each piece from Dark Matter, then upgrade it later into Red Matter Armor.$(br2)Each piece works like normal armor but never loses durability. Wearing the whole set reduces incoming damage by roughly $(l)56%$(), and every piece soaks up a flat amount of damage from each hit. That flat blocking is stronger against explosions, and boots help with falls while the helmet helps with drowning.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)The pieces are fireproof, so they survive lava.$(li)Damage that bypasses armor is not reduced at all.$(li)Wearing only part of the set grants only that piece's share of the bonus.
